info.title: Gozaq Production Backend API
info.description: Production-grade Go Backend API documentation powered by Scalar, Clean Architecture, Redis Caching, RBAC, and Prometheus Observability.

bearerAuth.description: Enter your JWT Access Token obtained from /api/v1/auth/login or /api/v1/auth/refresh

get.description: Liveness and readiness probe reporting real-time status of PostgreSQL, Redis, Goroutines, and Memory metrics.

errors.message: email must be a valid email address
password must be at least 6 characters

example.message: Too many requests. Please slow down.

post.description: Authenticates credentials and returns a short-lived Access Token and a long-lived Refresh Token stored in Redis.

example.message: Too many requests. Please slow down.

post.description: Validates refresh token against Redis, revokes the old token, and issues a brand new Access Token and Refresh Token pair.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or already revoked refresh token

post.description: Validates single-use email verification token from Redis and marks user account as verified in PostgreSQL.

example.message: Email verified successfully! Your account is now fully active.

post.description: Generates a new verification token and sends activation email via background worker pool.

200.description: Verification link sent if account is unverified

post.description: Generates a secure 32-byte crypto token in Redis (15m TTL) and sends password reset email without leaking user existence.

200.description: Reset instructions sent if email exists

example.message: If your email is registered, a password reset link has been sent

post.summary: Set New Password with Reset Token
post.description: Validates single-use reset token, hashes new password with bcrypt, updates DB, and revokes token.
Deletes the refresh token from Redis and evicts the user profile from Redis cache.

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid Bearer token

get.description: Retrieves the current user's profile. Checks Redis cache first (sub-millisecond latency); falls back to PostgreSQL on cache miss.

404.description: User profile not found in database

put.description: Updates profile details in PostgreSQL and immediately invalidates the Redis profile cache.
Changes the current user's password. Requires the correct current password.

post.description: Uploads a multipart form file (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, PDF, JSON max 5MB) and stores it with a unique UUID filename.

400.description: Missing file field or exceeds max size

example.message: Unsupported file format. Allowed: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, PDF, JSON

get.description: Retrieves paginated users list with search filter and sorting options. Protected by RBAC RequireRole('admin').

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search keyword for name or email

403.description: Forbidden - Current user role is not admin

delete.summary: Delete User by ID (Soft Delete, Admin Role Required)
delete.description: Soft deletes user by setting deleted_at timestamp in PostgreSQL and removes their cached profile from Redis. Protected by RBAC RequireRole('admin').

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the user to delete

403.description: Forbidden - Current user role is not admin

put.description: Changes user role (user/manager/admin), re-calculates permissions, and immediately invalidates profile/permission cache. Protected by 'roles:manage' permission.

get.description: Retrieves paginated audit trail logs of critical user activities. Protected by 'audit:read' permission.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Filter by action e.g. user.login, user.registered

get.summary: List All System Roles & Granted Permissions
get.description: Retrieves all roles (admin, manager, user) and their assigned granular permissions. Protected by 'roles:read' permission.
Retrieves the catalog of all granular permissions across all modules. Protected by 'roles:read' permission.
